bio.text: Tim Rogers, a Republican, won the August 2026 Republican primary for Wisconsin's 4th Congressional District, according to the Wisconsin Examiner's primary voter guide, which marks him as the winning candidate and reports he has run for the seat in every election cycle since 2018.
He is a Milwaukee native and, according to the Examiner, delivers gift baskets and newspapers for two local businesses.
His campaign website states that he volunteers in his community and sings in the All Saints Catholic Choir and the Milwaukee Public Schools Alumni Choir.
